initial-dialogue.player: Okay... I never mentioned werewolves though...

initial-dialogue.npc: Oh... Well, I was hoping to join a new crew, but I had no luck at Phasmatys. The ghosts there didn't seem to like me much... I thought maybe someone here would have a boat instead, but it seems not.

initial-dialogue.text: If the player has not completed Pandemonium:

steps.player: Well, I suppose it's not much of a bustling port. Still, I hope you find a crew soon.

initial-dialogue.text: If the player does not have 40 Sailing:

steps.player: Well, at some point I hope to hire a crew to sail with myself. I don't think I'm ready for that kind of thing yet though.

steps.npc: Right... Not very helpful to me then, are you?

steps.text: You need a Sailing level of 40 to manage a crew.

options.text: Maybe you'd like to join my crew?

steps.player: Maybe you'd like to join my crew?

steps.text: If the player does not have 65 Sailing or has not completed In Aid of the Myreque:

steps.npc: I don't think so. You're not fit to lead a pack.

steps.text: You require the following to recruit this crew member: Level 65 Sailing. Gained access to Burgh de Rott.

steps.npc: Hmm... Okay, I'll join your pack, but don't make me regret it.

steps.text: If the player has an open crew slot:
You recruit Oarswoman Olga as a crew member. She heads off in search of your boat.
